title_zh: 保留什么，适应哪里：持续妇科图像分割中遗忘的深度分析
title_en: What to Preserve, Where to Adapt: A Depth-Wise Analysis of Forgetting in Continual Gynecological Image Segmentation
summary_zh: 大多数医学图像分割模型假设所有数据同时可用，但临床实践中数据往往是顺序到达，模型需持续适应不断变化的数据分布。本文研究了妇科图像分割中的持续学习问题，面对影像模态、解剖结构和标注协议的巨大异质性，现有方法难以防止灾难性遗忘。通过编码器-解码器各部分的块级消融分析，发现早期编码器和后期解码器区域对性能影响最大；控制性适应实验显示仅更新瓶颈附近区域时遗忘有限，但更新较浅层时遗忘迅速增加。结果表明，在持续学习中遗忘程度受网络深度更新位置强烈影响。代码与分析将在论文接受后公开。
summary_en: Medical image segmentation models usually assume all data are available at once, but in clinical settings, data arrive sequentially requiring continuous model adaptation. This study focuses on continual learning in gynecological image segmentation, a challenging scenario due to high heterogeneity in imaging modalities, anatomy, and annotations. Block-wise ablation reveals early encoder and late decoder parts are critical for performance, while controlled experiments show forgetting is limited when updating bottleneck-adjacent regions but increases sharply when shallower encoders and decoders are updated. This indicates that forgetting in encoder-decoder architectures depends strongly on which network depths are updated during continual learning. Full code and analysis will be released upon acceptance.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究明确揭示了持续学习中编码器-解码器结构不同深度区域对遗忘的影响，有助于设计更有效的医学图像分割模型，尤其是面对实际临床中不断变化的数据分布时的适应策略。
why_it_matters_en: This work provides crucial insights into how different depth regions in encoder-decoder networks contribute to forgetting during continual learning, informing better model adaptation strategies for medical image segmentation in evolving clinical scenarios.

title_zh: Multiphase-Diff：针对高对比度多相物理系统中尖锐界面的扩散生成建模
title_en: Multiphase-Diff: Diffusion-Based Generative Modeling for High-Contrast Multiphase Physical Systems with Sharp Interfaces
summary_zh: 面对高对比度且具有尖锐界面的多相场，基于物理约束的扩散模型遇到三大挑战：系数跳变处强形式偏微分方程残差包含奇异梯度项，可能惩罚物理界面；极端对比度下低幅度相可能低于扩散噪声水平而被抹除、缩放错误或出现负系数；全局似然尺度导致高幅度相主导监督。Multiphase-Diff提出三项核心贡献：保守通量残差避免对不连续系数求导并保持离散守恒；解析双射映射将低幅度信号转换到阶数为1的潜变量尺度，并通过指数解码保证系数为正；Jacobi预条件似然归一化局部残差尺度，实现平衡监督。多项多相基准测试表明，该方法在物理和分布一致性方面优于七种基线，对不同相对比度和组成具备鲁棒性，证明了其在科学样本生成中的有效性。
summary_en: Physics-constrained diffusion for high-contrast multiphase fields with sharp interfaces encounters three key difficulties: singular gradient terms at coefficient jumps penalize physical interfaces; low-magnitude phases may fall below noise floor leading to erasure or negative generation; and global likelihood scales cause high-magnitude phases to dominate supervision. Multiphase-Diff addresses these by (i) conservative flux residuals avoiding differentiation of discontinuous coefficients and enforcing discrete conservation; (ii) analytic bijective mappings scaling low signals to order-one latent variables ensuring positive coefficients via exponential decoding; and (iii) Jacobi-preconditioned likelihoods normalizing local residuals for balanced supervision. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate superiority over seven baselines in physical and distribution fidelity and robustness across contrasts and compositions, confirming its efficacy for scientific sample generation.
why_it_matters_zh: 此研究解决了传统扩散生成模型在高对比度、多相物理系统中因系数跳变和极端幅度引起的物理界面和数据一致性问题，提出创新方法保证了物理守恒、数值稳定及平衡监督，显著提升了生成模型的科学样本质量与适用范围。
why_it_matters_en: This work tackles key challenges in physics-constrained diffusion models caused by coefficient discontinuities and extreme phase contrasts in high-contrast multiphase systems. By introducing conservative flux residuals, bijective analytic mappings, and normalized likelihoods, it ensures physical conservation, numerical stability, and balanced supervision, thereby significantly improving the quality and applicability of generative models for scientific sample generation.

Evaluated across datasets and state-of-the-art generators, PROVE outperforms optimization, captioning, and RL-based methods in image similarity and text-image alignment without training or generator access, offering a practical and auditable prompt recovery approach.

title_en: Inducing Reward-Free Judging Rubrics that Reduce Over-Crediting in Agent Evaluation
summary_zh: 本文提出RubricForge，一种基于少量带标签轨迹，通过反思进化生成的文本判分规则，用于无奖励环境下自动评估语言模型代理。相较于现有手写或微调的判分器，RubricForge更忠实于真实环境奖励，显著减少了对失败轨迹的过度加分，在tau-bench和WebShop数据集上表现出更低的假通过率和更佳的排序一致性。其判分规则为人类可读文本，便于追踪判决依据。
summary_en: This paper introduces RubricForge, a method that induces a text-based judging rubric from a small set of ground-truth-labeled trajectories via reflective evolution, enabling reward-free evaluation of language-model agents. Compared to existing hand-written or fine-tuned judges, RubricForge is more faithful to true environment rewards, significantly reducing false positive passes on failed trajectories. Experiments on tau-bench and WebShop datasets show lower false-pass rates and improved ranking faithfulness. The resulting rubric is human-readable, making verdicts attributable to named criteria.
why_it_matters_zh: 自动评估语言模型代理通常缺乏可获取的环境奖励，导致现有判分器容易对失败表现过度加分，影响评估公正。RubricForge通过生成可解释的判分规则，减少这一问题，提高了评估的可信度与实用性。
why_it_matters_en: Automatic evaluation of language-model agents often lacks accessible environment rewards, causing existing judges to over-credit failed behaviors and reduce fairness. RubricForge addresses this by generating interpretable scoring rubrics grounded in true outcomes, thereby improving evaluation trustworthiness and practical relevance.

title_zh: 通过基于幅值的专家屏蔽对Mixture-of-Experts模型进行层深敏感性分析
title_en: Depth-Aware Sensitivity Analysis of Mixture-of-Experts Models via Magnitude-Based Expert Masking
summary_zh: 本文针对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型（40层MoE，每层256个专家，top-8路由）在XLCoST跨语言代码翻译基准上，采用基于幅值的专家屏蔽对各层敏感性进行系统分析。研究发现模型不同深度层对专家屏蔽的敏感性差异显著，早期（0-9层）和中期层（10-29层）对屏蔽高度敏感，而后期层（30-39层）尤其是35-39层对低幅值专家的屏蔽表现出较强容忍度。针对30%专家屏蔽，若均匀施行会显著降低性能，而集中于后期层的策略则能在屏蔽大量专家的同时保留较高质量输出。减少top-k路由宽度也带来显著的时钟周期减少且无性能损失。该工作为深度感知的MoE专家屏蔽提供了实证基础，并指明了进行权重手术、激活评分及训练恢复的路径。
summary_en: This paper conducts a systematic layer-wise sensitivity analysis of the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model with 40 MoE layers using magnitude-based expert masking on the XLCoST cross-lingual code translation benchmark. Results reveal strong depth-dependent sensitivity: early and middle layers are fragile to masking, while late layers, especially layers 35-39, tolerate aggressive masking of low-magnitude experts. Uniform 30% masking reduces output quality significantly, whereas late-layer-focused masking retains high-quality outputs while masking many experts. Additionally, reducing top-k routing width from 8 to 6 lowers wall-clock time without loss in quality. This work empirically supports depth-aware MoE expert masking and guides future directions including weight surgery, activation scoring, and training recovery.
why_it_matters_zh: 理解MoE模型中不同层对专家屏蔽的敏感性，有助于有效进行模型压缩和推理优化，提升大规模模型的计算效率和部署灵活性。该研究通过实验证明，只对后期层进行屏蔽能在保持模型性能的情况下大幅减少活跃专家数量，为未来基于激活的专家评估和权重手术提供了数据支持。
why_it_matters_en: Understanding layer-wise sensitivity to expert masking in MoE models aids efficient model compression and inference optimization, enhancing computational efficiency and deployment flexibility of large-scale models. This study empirically demonstrates that masking focused on later layers preserves performance while significantly reducing active experts, providing data-driven guidance for activation-based expert scoring and weight surgery approaches.

summary_zh: StreamHear 是一个半监督学习流程，针对领域偏移的目标音频提升流式自动语音识别性能。它通过先离线微调转录教师模型生成伪标签，再用混合标签数据细调流式学生模型，并引入先验正则化的动态规划重对齐步骤，修正词语定位。在金融电话、标准朗读语音和电话质量对话四个数据集上，StreamHear 稳定超越了仅监督学习的学生模型并缩小了与离线教师的性能差距。

title_zh: BM25增强的多示例翻译用于低资源东北印度语言
title_en: BM25-Augmented Many-Shot Translation for Low-Resource North-Eastern Indian Languages
summary_zh: 本文介绍了佛罗里达大学Gators团队参加WMT26低资源印地语翻译共享任务的方案。系统采用基于检索增强的多示例翻译流程，实现英语与11种东北印度语言间的双向翻译。推理时，BM25从特定语言的训练库中检索最相似的平行示例，Gemini 2.5 Flash模型基于这些示例进行翻译，无需模型微调。训练库结合官方WMT26数据及公开语料如Samanantar和往届WMT共享任务数据。系统通过网格搜索调优检索和示例数量，优化22个语言方向对的表现。
summary_en: This paper presents the University of Florida Gators' submission to the WMT26 Low-Resource Indic Language Translation shared task. Their system uses a retrieval-augmented many-shot translation pipeline for bidirectional translation between English and eleven North-Eastern Indian languages. During inference, BM25 retrieves the most similar parallel examples from a language-specific training bank, and Gemini 2.5 Flash translates the input conditioned on these examples without any model fine-tuning. The training banks combine official WMT26 data with publicly available corpora such as Samanantar and previous WMT shared task releases. A grid search over retrieval parameters optimizes performance across all 22 language-direction pairs.

title_zh: 当词汇变化误导时：用传统及大语言模型指标重新思考动态主题模型评估
title_en: When Lexical Change Misleads: Rethinking Dynamic Topic Model Evaluation with Traditional and LLM-Based Metrics
summary_zh: 本文研究动态主题模型在捕捉随时间演变的词分布时，传统一致性指标在词汇变化但语义不变的情况下表现不足。通过对NYT、DBLP和arXiv三语料库中120个主题的评估，分为低、中、高词汇变化类别，发现传统指标与人工判断一致性波动较大（相关系数-0.256到0.614）。相比之下，大语言模型基于语义相似度的指标与人工语义判断高度一致，尤其在CoNTM模型中效果显著。词汇变化分层揭示了整体评价中隐藏的差异，作者主张结合传统一致性与大语言模型语义指标进行词汇变化意识下的综合评估。
summary_en: This work examines how traditional coherence metrics for dynamic topic models fail when vocabulary changes despite stable semantic meaning. Evaluating 120 topics from CoNTM and DLDA over NYT, DBLP, and arXiv corpora, categorized by low, medium, and high lexical change, the study finds traditional temporal coherence shows highly variable agreement with human judgments (correlations from -0.256 to 0.614). By contrast, LLM-based semantic similarity aligns strongly with human semantic judgments, especially for CoNTM. Lexical-change stratification uncovers variations hidden in aggregate evaluations. The authors advocate for lexical-change-aware evaluation that jointly reports traditional coherence and LLM semantic metrics as complementary rather than interchangeable signals.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了传统主题模型评估指标在面对词汇变化时的局限，强调结合大语言模型语义相似度提升评价的准确性和可靠性，对动态主题模型研究和应用具有指导意义。
why_it_matters_en: The research highlights limitations of traditional topic model evaluation metrics under lexical change and emphasizes integrating LLM-based semantic similarity to improve the accuracy and reliability of assessments, providing valuable guidance for dynamic topic modeling research and applications.
